findings.evidence: R-03 (minCONSENSUS_PCT 67 vs 80, ConsensusParms.h:79, E01) + R-04 (ValidatorList.cpp:1897-1900, E02) + R-05 (amendment majority 67/100 vs 80/100, SystemParameters.h:85, E03) + threshold table: UNL 100 needs 67 vs 80 agreeing; UNL 35 needs 24 vs 28; UNL 21 needs 15 vs 17.
findings.title: The 67% quorum validates with 13 fewer agreeing validators out of 100 than rippled, and the tolerated Byzantine share rises from 20% to 33%

findings.evidence: R-34 (Transactor.cpp:190-212, E31) + R-26 (exclusion cache on first validated ledger, LedgerMaster.cpp:290, E24) + R-37 (PF_AccountExclusion amendment, features.macro:45, E34) + scenario S-07 run A (diverged).
findings.title: Exclusion enforcement is a consensus-level account block: postfiatd rejects transactions from or to excluded accounts at preflight, rippled applies them normally, so the same transaction has different outcomes on the two implementations

findings.evidence: R-06 (RCLConsensus.cpp:709-728 vs rippled :704-728, E04) + scenario S-03 run A (diverged: median offset 0 s, mean offset 11 s) and run B (matched: all peers on time).
findings.title: Close-time offset is a weighted median in postfiatd and an arithmetic mean in rippled: one peer 120 seconds off moves the mean by 11 seconds and the median by 0

findings.evidence: R-07 (Consensus.h:1602-1613 vs rippled :1605-1616, E05) + scenario S-04 run A (diverged: postfiatd picks 1000, rippled picks 1005).
findings.title: Close-time tie-break flips: among bins tied for the most votes the earliest wins in postfiatd and the latest wins in rippled, so the same votes pick different consensus close times

findings.evidence: R-08 (Consensus.h:1283-1294, E06) + scenario S-05 run A (diverged) and run B (matched at 90%).
findings.title: Pause-phase thresholds fall with the quorum (67/75/83/92 vs 80/85/90/95), so a network where 70% of validators moved on pauses in rippled and proceeds in postfiatd

findings.title: Parse hardening caps inputs rippled accepts: JSON arrays over 512 elements are rejected, negative variable-length sizes are rejected, and peer validations must be in canonical field order

findings.title: Unlisted validator manifests are bounded at 1,000 in postfiatd with the oldest evicted; rippled keeps them unbounded, so a manifest flood grows its cache without limit
